objective: Improve general test-composition and semantic reasoning on all 17 existing trials; seek zero false alarms and zero misses, otherwise retain the best verified trade-off within ten hours.
initial_hypothesis: The retained generator already exposes useful semantic obligations. Evidence retrieval and review allocation should be tested before widening its construction space.
round_requirements: Commit each round with implementation, frozen settings, costs and results.
No task, repository, known-witness or candidate-ID conditions in the algorithm.
Keep evaluator labels, reference code and hidden tests outside generation, ranking and model evidence.
Fix provider requests and candidate selection before evaluation.
Use complete valid tests and native failures to adjudicate alerts; model support alone is insufficient.
Unknown contracts and unreviewed alarms remain unknown; no zero-FP claim without auditing every emitted alert.
Retain all 17 trials including unsupported and uncompleted ones.
Do not pool best witnesses from different configurations into a single-run result.

provisional_resource_policy.user_cost_limit: Asked asynchronously; no reply yet. Start with small batches.

selection_policy.primary: Attempt full 17-trial coverage with no invalid reported alarms.
selection_policy.fallback: Retain nondominated verified methods; select by conservative F1 of emitted-alert precision and 17-trial coverage, then fewer false alarms, then lower cost.
selection_policy.unknowns: Unknown emitted alerts cannot count as true positives. Report them separately rather than calling them confirmed false alarms.
selection_policy.all_alert_audit: Final bounded reports must be reviewed in full. Unemitted research failures are not reported alarms.
